annotations.text:
InkTag — 5 layout directions, same visual language (colors/type lifted from App.axaml), different information architecture.

Current  — spreadsheet + right inspector + modal dialogs.  Baseline.
A · Library Rail  — add a left nav rail: smart-lists (Untagged / Modified / Errors) always visible, browse by publisher/series without typing.  Lowest-risk evolution; costs ~220px of width.
B · Cover Wall  — covers replace rows; status shows as ribbons/outlines; edit in a side drawer.  Best for “which of these needs work” at a glance; weak for bulk column edits.
C · Health Dashboard  — land on a library-health overview (tiles, % tagged, needs-attention queue, big actions); grid is one tab away.  Reframes the app around the goal; adds a screen to navigate.
D · Tagging Workspace  — the scrape/match dialog becomes a full screen you work a queue in: local cover + field diff + candidates + Apply&Next.  Turns tagging into a fast loop; only useful while actively tagging.
